summary: Credicorp Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its board approved a cash dividend of S/50.00 per share (approximately S/4.7 billion total) payable on June 12, 2026 to holders of record on May 18, 2026. The dividend will be paid in U.S. dollars using the Peruvian Superintendency's exchange rate. This is an ordinary dividend declaration from net income for 2025. No special-situation event is involved. The filing is a routine material event notice under Peruvian requirements, mapped to a Form 6-K for a foreign private issuer. No acquisition, restructuring, or capital return program beyond regular dividends.
